generation.wall_deadline_policy: Before each request, use the absolute task wall deadline; after pacing, provider timeout is min(180 seconds, remaining task time), and no request starts after the deadline.
generation.source_basis: S1 full-workload acceptance caps; unchanged MiniMax M3 and generation interface
generation.eg_e0_contract: Both arms receive and must return the same four-field strategy_hypothesis schema; EG alone receives deterministic history context.

data.count_source: chapter6_demo.benchmarks._instances_cached for V12_TSP_PROFILE; counts are configured per each of three families, yielding 12/36/60 per block and 48/60 evaluations.
data.test_policy: Do not materialize a Test snapshot, execute the task evaluator on Test, or expose any Test quality output until all search jobs in the stage are terminal and every available validation selection is frozen. The offline full-corpus overlap audit may compute opaque IDs and coordinate hashes only; it does not execute route programs or compute quality metrics.

hypotheses.H1: History-informed direction generation yields more valid, near-incumbent starts than parentless history-free exploration and improves downstream gains; stage B/C are diagnostic only, and independent support requires both a higher block-level valid-near-start rate and a Holm-adjusted lower confidence bound of at least +0.3 pp for TestGap(M*-G)-TestGap(M*).
hypotheses.H2: Stable investment identity, finite trials and evidence-based renewal preserve worthwhile lagging directions whose returns exceed opportunity cost.
hypotheses.H3: At equal frozen resource ceilings, matured-return and opportunity-cost allocation improves final single-program Test quality over a strong fixed allocation; costs are separately reported and are not an alternative confirmatory claim.
hypotheses.H4: Supported components remain interpretable on independent data, wider decision spaces and another task carrier.

A.scope: offline implementation, replay and synthetic boundary acceptance
required_checks: no quota reset by duplicate, recovery or rename
switch trigger versus actual decision change

branch_selection.eligible: valid non-identical program with validation loss difference in (0, 0.035] and probe behavior distance > 0.08
branch_selection.winner: minimum validation loss, then minimum node id
branch_selection.behavior_distance: chapter6_demo.benchmarks.behavior_distance over aligned probe behavior descriptors; strict threshold > 0.08

B.starting_reference_test_policy: After the global gate, evaluate one validation-selected starting incumbent and one eligible branch per checkpoint; unavailable branch stays missing.
B.branch_missing_rule: retain B as unavailable; never replace or resample checkpoint
B.test_freeze: freeze validation-selected candidates at proposals 4 and 8 for every action/repetition; open Test only after all 128 jobs terminate
B.interpretation: Diagnostic estimation only. Stage B cannot declare H1 support, regardless of point estimates or nominal intervals; report every block, endpoint, missing result, and cost.

C.interpretation: Development screening only. Stage C estimates conditional component differences and selects or deletes components; no confirmatory claim or interaction inference is allowed.
C.test_freeze: open Test only after all 48 jobs are terminal and selection files are frozen

D.primary_endpoint: final single-program Test gap at equal fixed resource budget
D.component_benefit_contrast: TestGap(M*-component)-TestGap(M*); positive favors retaining the component
D.component_confirmatory_rule: a Holm-adjusted block-level confidence-interval lower bound of at least +0.3 pp; harmful when its upper bound is at most -0.3 pp; practical benefit insufficient when the whole interval is inside (-0.3,+0.3) pp

component_process_gates.G: block-level valid-near-incumbent start-rate interval lower bound > 0
component_process_gates.P: block-level renewed mature-return minus best observed contemporaneous alternative interval lower bound > 0

D.joint_hypothesis_priority: Report the Test-effect category and joint-hypothesis category separately for H1/H2. Joint support requires both the process gate and Test support; Test harm or Test-equivalence categories remain harmful or practical-benefit-insufficient regardless of the process gate; all other cases, including a failed/unestimable process gate with a positive Test effect, are joint evidence_insufficient.
D.component_removed_at_development_rule: retain corresponding H status as evidence_insufficient and do not claim independent confirmation; do not infer a zero effect
D.H3_endpoint: final single-program Test quality under equal frozen token/proposal/wall ceilings; no budget-efficiency claim
D.authorization: No new call budget identified; require powered fixed-N matrix and explicit budget authorization before dispatch.

budget_assumptions.unknown_sent_request_cost: unknown; retained as missing and not silently set to zero
budget_assumptions.provider_call_cost_currency: not estimated; repository contains no applicable price schedule/authorization
budget_assumptions.summary_generation: local deterministic serialization, no separate model call; summary tokens are part of the actual planner input usage and serialization CPU/wall time is recorded

freeze_gates: stage C candidate selected without post hoc tuning
stage D N and total budget computed before authorization
